title: TMAX 560 Tech MAX (Urban Commuter)
description: The Yamaha TMAX 560 Tech MAX (Urban Commuter) delivers muscular mid-range acceleration paired with effortless city maneuvering for riders demanding purposeful real-world performance. Its tuned powertrain delivers immediate, tractable torque against its responsive chassis architecture, ensuring responsive roll-on acceleration in demanding road conditions. With a balanced 790mm seat height providing confident footing and natural knee comfort and a balanced Upright Neutral layout, it maintains ergonomic composure across extended highway and city riding.
